mechanism: Torsemide-induced fluid and electrolyte depletion may impair immune function and increase infection risk, while infliximab's immunosuppression combined with loop diuretic use increases susceptibility to serious infections and renal complications.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and signs of infection closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative diuretics if possible and evaluate necessity of TNF inhibitor therapy in volume-depleted states.
